expectedDefinitions.Fees: Total validator fees on ssv.network: network fee (set by the DAO) plus operator fees (set by each operator in a free market). Denominated in SSV before the April 2026 SSV Staking / cSSV migration and in ETH after it.
expectedDefinitions.UserFees: Pre-migration metric: fees paid by stakers running validators (operator + network fees), equal to total Fees. SSV-denominated.
expectedDefinitions.Revenue: Network fees, the protocol's share of validator fees. Pre-migration these accrued to the DAO treasury, post-migration they are distributed to cSSV stakers.
expectedDefinitions.ProtocolRevenue: Pre-migration metric: network fees allocated to the SSV DAO treasury minus SSV burned from the treasury, so it is negative on burn days. Not applicable after the migration, when network fees go to cSSV stakers instead.
expectedDefinitions.SupplySideRevenue: Operator fees earned by node operators running the distributed validator infrastructure (SSV-denominated pre-migration, ETH after).
expectedDefinitions.HoldersRevenue: Value accruing to holders: SSV token burns pre-migration; ETH network fees distributed to cSSV stakers post-migration.

limits: Meaning includes the stated 2026-04-22 era switch; do not label current Revenue as cash retained by DAO.
FeesSynced is accrual to staking pool at synchronization, not proof of individual holder withdrawals.
decisions.reviewReason: Revenue is network fee portion of validator-service payments; pre-migration protocol earnings from graph, post-migration sum of FeesSynced.newFeesWei. Operator remuneration is separately supply-side. Post-migration recipient is cSSV stakers, not DAO treasury; both retain the protocol fee economic base.

limits: Operator amount is an estimate; changing rate/count within window can change accuracy.

decisions.reviewReason: Validator users pay network plus operator charges. Current operator amount is fee-per-block times validator count from end-block state times period blocks. This estimator remains user-fee economics.

decisions.recipient: SSV burn pre-migration; cSSV stakers post-migration
decisions.funding: treasury balances pre-migration; ETH network fees post-migration
decisions.temporal: burn event or synced network-fee window
limits: Preserve both raw mechanisms and migration date; no inference from Revenue==HoldersRevenue.
No same-period holderShare approval.
decisions.reviewReason: Two mechanisms share one series: pre-migration all SSV transfers to zero address (without sender treasury filter), post-migration ETH fees synchronized to cSSV pool. Blanket market_buyback or cash_distribution approval would misstate at least one era.
decisions.missingProof: Explicit era-scoped mechanism decision: bound legacy burns to eligible funding/recipient scope and confirm current cSSV fee-accrual entitlement under an accepted staking_distribution policy.

{
  "ts-node": {
    "compilerOptions": {
      "module": "commonjs"

    "target": "ES2020",
